pp_tip.credentials_forgotten: PayPal access deleted. The donation page no longer accepts anything.
pp_tip.credentials_where: Both are in your PayPal developer account under “Apps & Credentials”. Mind whether you are on “Sandbox” or “Live” there – the keys differ.
pp_tip.done.already_hint: This donation was already booked – nothing was charged twice. Thank you!
pp_tip.done.failed: The payment did not go through
pp_tip.done.failed_hint: PayPal did not complete it. If money was charged anyway, say so in chat – it will be booked by hand.
pp_tip.done.thanks_hint: Your donation of %{amount} € arrived. The bar in the stream will grow in a moment.
pp_tip.done.unknown: This donation is not known here
pp_tip.done.unknown_hint: Nothing is on file for this PayPal payment. If money was charged, say so in chat.
pp_tip.error.no_approve_url: PayPal did not return an address to pay at. Please try again in a moment.
pp_tip.error.paypal_down: PayPal is not responding right now. Please try again in a moment.
pp_tip.error.rate_limit: Too many requests to PayPal. Please wait a moment.
pp_tip.error.unauthorized: PayPal refuses the access. Client ID and secret are probably wrong – or they belong to the other mode (sandbox instead of live).
pp_tip.fee_hint: This only computes the suggestion when someone ticks “cover the fees”. What PayPal actually deducts shows up in the settlement – and that is the value that lands on the goal.
pp_tip.secret_set: stored – leave empty to keep it
pp_tip.settings_lead: Client ID and secret from your PayPal developer account, plus the fee rates for the “cover the fees” suggestion.
